issuer: the Wyoming Department of Transportation, Driver Services
note: WYDOT's ID card page (read 2026-10-30) gives the card at $10 with an expiration of eight years, issued to residents of any age (so the card has no age). The driver licence's fee, term and age weren't found on the pages read (the licence page states none), so only the card is held; the licence is reported as not reached.

sources.title: WYDOT, ID Cards
sources.said: Identification cards may be issued to Wyoming residents of any age. ... The cost of an identification card is $10. Identification cards are issued with an expiration date of eight years.
